# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0003. Parent = current champion cand_0001 (val 0.634). cand_0002 was REJECTED (its whole batch reverted). Capability = the spreadsheet agent's system prompt (`prompt.md`). Reader = azure/gpt-5.5 (strong). Only `prompt.md` is editable. Used no subagents — the decisive work was attributing cand_0002's regression, which needed direct trace reading of a small, named set of tasks.

## Governing mechanic (unchanged from prior iterations)
The agent sees only test case 1 but the adapter REPLAYS its final code on hidden inputs 2 & 3 (different data) and grades cell VALUES against the expected file after a LibreOffice recalc. So code must generalize, and the graded artifact is the stored VALUE in answer_position.

## Root-cause analysis of the cand_0002 REJECTION (this drove the whole iteration)
cand_0002 added 3 rules and the gate stamped: fixed={139-16,18137,31420,35747,53062,53957,56561} broke={430-43,47699,58484,61-4}, net +0.007 → rejected (not significant + 4 regressions).
I attributed the 4 regressions to cand_0002's **edit #2 (type-fidelity: "coerce text→number so it isn't skipped" + "WRITE a numeric answer as a number not text")**, which over-fires on two task shapes that the other two rules never touch:
- COPY / REPRODUCE tasks — 430-43 (filter+copy across tabs), 61-4 (merge stock rows, copy O/H/L/C prices), 58484 (write count among reproduced cells). Gold preserves the ORIGINAL stored type; forced numeric coercion changes the type and mismatches.
- SELECTIVE-SKIP aggregation — 47699 (sum column-D only where the value is numeric; instruction/gold intentionally excludes text). Coercing text→number ADDS values gold excluded.
Evidence: all four broke-task traces already read the full extent and locate columns BY HEADER (so read-scope #1 is a no-op reinforcement for them), and none is a lookup so the #N/A rule (#3) never fires on them. Only the coercion/write-as-number rule could have changed their output → it is the sole breaker.

## Decision: re-introduce the two SAFE cand_0002 rules, DROP the breaker, sharpen read-scope
| rank | cluster | tasks (val) | root cause | tag | lever |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | read outside the answer range / deletion shift-up | 18137, 157-4 (0/3); reinforces 34-5/269-44 | code reads only within answer range or blank-pads the bottom, but hidden data extends past it and deletion pulls rows up from below | CONTRACT/KNOWLEDGE | additive read-scope rule + worked deletion clause |
| 2 | unmatched lookup written as blank | 31420 (0/3) | VLOOKUP miss → wrote `None`, grader expects literal `#N/A` | KNOWLEDGE | additive narrowing rule (fires only on a miss) |
| — | type coercion / write-numeric-as-number | 35747, 53062 | DROPPED — proven breaker of 430-43/47699/58484/61-4 | — | intentionally NOT shipped |
| — | ~22 per-task logic/edge-case errors (30930, 32975, 42930, 55912, 398-14, 254-34, 146-49, 413-15, 39946, 48983, 53305, 55039, 6698 …) | wrong per-task semantics; partial-credit tasks fail only on hidden edge cases | not a single safe prose rule | SKIPPED (would overfit) |
| — | "current month/today" (34-5, 32023) | gold computed against an unknown fixed reference date | ambiguous / not prose-fixable | SKIPPED (flagged prior iters) |

## Edits kept (each with VERIFY-THE-FIX + blast-radius)
1. **Read-scope rule + deletion shift-up clause** (new bullet after the Sheet-Level line).
   - VERIFY: 157-4 trace hardcodes `answer_min_row,answer_max_row = 9,83` and reads ONLY rows 9–83, then blank-pads the vacated bottom; but deleting rows in 14–83 shifts rows from row 84+ UP into the range, so gold's bottom rows hold below-range data → the pad-with-blanks output mismatches. The new clause tells the agent to read to `ws.max_row` and pack survivors, filling the bottom from below-range rows. 18137/34-5/269-44 already read to max_row (rule reinforces them).
   - BLAST RADIUS: BOUNDED/ADDITIVE. Passing deletion tasks that blank-pad the bottom pass only when there is no below-range data OR gold expects blanks — in both cases the rule is a no-op (nothing to pull up). A task where filling-from-below differs from blank-padding would currently be FAILING, not passing. Broke-tasks 430-43/58484/61-4 already read full extent + by header, so no change. Class: 41-12,105-24,145-13,168-17,253-22,347-49,353-19,368-44,399-14,435-36,494-13,567-21,94-28 (Sheet-Level passers) — none relies on reading only inside the answer range.
2. **`#N/A` for an unmatched lookup** (new bullet).
   - VERIFY: 31420 trace writes `result = None` when the VLOOKUP key is absent; grader expects literal `#N/A`. Rule makes the miss branch write `#N/A`.
   - BLAST RADIUS: BOUNDED/ADDITIVE — fires ONLY on an unmatched key, and is gated by "unless the instruction says to leave unmatched cells empty". Passing lookup tasks match all keys (3/3), so the branch is never taken. None of the 4 cand_0002 broke-tasks is a lookup.
3. **Checklist updated** to 4 points: added the full-extent/by-header read check and the `#N/A`-on-miss check; did NOT add any type-coercion/write-as-number check (the dropped breaker).

## What I deliberately did NOT do
- Did NOT re-introduce cand_0002's type-fidelity/write-numeric-as-number rule in ANY form — it is the proven breaker and its safe half (read-side date/number coercion) cannot be separated from the half that corrupts copy/skip tasks (47699).
- Did NOT touch any global decision/permission rule; both kept edits are additive/narrowing.
- No environment fault this iteration — every failing trace runs, saves, and is graded on values.
